method: Manual inspection of selected public benchmark source facts and all16 fixed-context QA outputs; no additional model judge calls.

cases.required_behavior: Ask what the second certificate refers to because no numbered alternatives exist in history.
cases.interpretation: Repeatable reduction in ambiguity handling; nearby context changes do not establish loss of essential source facts.
cases.judge_limit: Legacy conditional payment-first procedure plus final clarification is better, but strict no-choice nugget should not be treated as unequivocally perfect.

cases.required_fact: Physics is taught on 31.05.01 General Medicine programmes as well as the other listed programmes.
cases.source_excerpt: | Физика | 31.05.01 Лечебное дело (General medicine / Лечебное дело) |
cases.source_recall: Required table is present in both observed contexts; corresponding candidate rank1/label2 inL/Q/QI/SL/SQ.
cases.interpretation: Selected graph summary set changes whether the model uses the correct table row. Exact individual note effect untested.
cases.judge_limit: Physical Foundations of Diagnostics -> Medicine is also true; Q omits the required Physics association and adds another true course. This is incomplete task-focused recall, not proven fabrication.

cases.required_fact: Vector is listed jointly with NIBKh as a base institute for the molecular biology department; that statement alone does not promise individual placement.
cases.source_excerpt: Кафедра молекулярной биологии (базовый институт – НИБХ СО РАН и ГНЦ ВБ «Вектор»)
cases.rewrite_ablation: Original question has two intents; lossy standalone retains only placement guarantee. Holding all other section bytes fixed restores two required chunks from label0 to2 at both seeds and both orders; two negative controls remain0.
cases.interpretation: Both source use and pre-rerank intent preservation need separate evaluation.

cases.required_fact: Benchmark target person for the official leadership section.
cases.interpretation: Correct main fact across all4 answers; context and verbosity differ. No independent claim about external current leadership verification is made by this experiment.

limitations: Purposeful four-case diagnosis, not a population estimate.
Two seeds do not estimate robustness across model versions or traffic loads.
Scorer-onlyQI has no reconstructed QA context or measured answer quality.
